scenarios.title: A cipher card encoded on a creature casts a free copy when the creature hits a player

setup.notes: A's library lists the top card first.

decisions: A casts Last Thoughts, tapping the four Islands. B passes (see variants) and it resolves: A draws a card.
A exiles Last Thoughts encoded on Grizzly Bears.
A moves to combat and attacks player B with Grizzly Bears. B declares no blockers. Combat damage is dealt.
If Grizzly Bears's trigger fires, A casts a copy of Last Thoughts without paying its mana cost; it resolves.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Last Thoughts is in exile, encoded on Grizzly Bears. Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18), the trigger fires, and the free copy resolves. A draws a second card; A's library is empty.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Grizzly Bears with Runeclaw Bear.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals combat damage to Runeclaw Bear, not to a player, so the trigger does not fire. Both creatures are destroyed. B's life stays 20. Last Thoughts stays in exile; A drew only one card.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Last Thoughts, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Last Thoughts is countered and goes to A's graveyard; A draws no card and nothing is encoded. Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18) and no trigger fires.

scenarios.title: Encoding is lost when the creature leaves the battlefield and returns

setup.notes: Last Thoughts is exiled and encoded on Raging Goblin.

decisions: A moves to combat and attacks player B with Raging Goblin. B has no creatures and declares no blockers. Combat damage is dealt.
If Raging Goblin's trigger fires, A casts a copy of Last Thoughts without paying its mana cost; it resolves.

variants.label: still_encoded
variants.expected: Raging Goblin deals 1 combat damage to B (life 19). The trigger fires and the free copy of Last Thoughts resolves: A draws the Island.

variants.label: flickered
variants.delta: Before combat, A casts Cloudshift targeting Raging Goblin, tapping Plains, and it resolves; the returned Raging Goblin then attacks.
variants.expected: Raging Goblin returns as a new object, no longer encoded. It deals 1 combat damage to B (life 19) but no trigger fires; A draws no card.

scenarios.forge_notes: Raging Goblin has haste, so the returned object can attack. In the flickered variant Cloudshift is cast in main1 before combat.

scenarios.title: A card stays encoded when the creature changes controller

setup.notes: Last Thoughts is owned by A, exiled and encoded on A's Raging Goblin.

decisions: B casts Act of Treason targeting Raging Goblin, tapping all three Mountains; it resolves. B gains control of Raging Goblin until end of turn, untaps it and it gains haste.
B moves to combat and attacks player A with Raging Goblin. A declares no blockers. Combat damage is dealt.
If Raging Goblin's trigger fires, B casts a copy of Last Thoughts without paying its mana cost; it resolves.

variants.label: encoded_creature_stolen
variants.expected: Raging Goblin deals 1 combat damage to A (life 19). The trigger fires for B, its new controller, and the free copy resolves: B draws the Island. Last Thoughts stays in exile.

variants.label: other_creature_stolen
variants.delta: B targets Mons's Goblin Raiders with Act of Treason and attacks with it instead.
variants.expected: Mons's Goblin Raiders deals 1 combat damage to A (life 19). It has no encoded card, so no trigger fires; B draws no card.
